========================================================================
Separated less-than signs are not a shift
:language(typescript)
:language(tsx)
:error
========================================================================

const invalid=value < <amount;

---

==================

:language(typescript)
:language(tsx)
==================

const first = factory <<T extends Map<string, {value: ")>"}>>(value: T) => T>(identity);
const second = factory<<T = `${`>`}`>(value: T) => T>(identity);
const third = factory<</* parameter */ const T>(value: {text: ")=>"}) /* arrow */ => T>(identity);
const fourth = factory<<T>(callback: (value: T) => T) => T>(identity);
